body: Possibly related to #1347 if the binary aspect is a red herring?
Hi @olets, can you run `RUST_LOG=trace starship prompt` and post the results here to help us debug this.

I think this is solved! Realized zsh doesn't load zshrc in non-interactive shells:

```shell
% test_string
abc
% zsh -c 'test_string'
zsh:1: command not found: test_string
```

Sourcing zshrc in the custom module's command works:

```toml
[custom.my_command_defined_in_zshrc]
command = ". ~/.zshrc && my_command"
shell = ["zsh"]
when = "true"
prefix = ""
```

Hi @olets, sorry I should have caught that first time around. Yep we don't load the shell rc files by default since we don't want to get stuck in an infinite loop where the custom module loads starship which runs the custom module which loads starship again. I'm going to close this now but if more users experience this issue we can always update the docs to clarify.

Yeah once I thought about it in the right terms instead of as a Starship bug, of course the shell wouldn't load the interactive environment on every command. The current behavior is the way it should be.

Thanks!
